description: Join LaKesha Womack and North Carolina Democratic Party Chair Anderson Clayton for the Burke County stop of the Rooted in Community Tour. Meet us for an informal conversation with community leaders and neighbors about the opportunities and challenges facing Burke County.
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Committee to Elect LaKesha Womack
title: Rooted in Community: Burke County Listening Tour — LaKesha Womack for NC-14
